title: Campus Cyber Crisis
boss_motive: Kengore, the cybernetic evolution of Tonian, believes he is the pinnacle of human perfection. He seeks to conquer the campus with his automated army and replace the student body with code.
intro: Kengore's mechanical forces have taken over the university quad! Drones and droids enforce his perfectionist regime across the grounds. Fight your way to the Beckman building to unplug his supreme ego!
boss_taunt: Flesh is obsolete! Bow down before the pinnacle of evolution!
outro: Kengore's cybernetic systems crash as his orbital targeter powers down. The campus is saved from total automated takeover!
scenery: The path begins at the grand Beckman building with its red brick facade, glass curtain tower, green roof trim, and obelisk statue, then moves past brick university halls, manicured lawns framed by globe streetlamps, bare winter trees, paved plazas, and lower campus academic buildings under a twilight pixelated sky.

join_cover: one tall full-grown leafy oak tree, trunk and roots at the bottom, a broad round crown of green leaves at the top, seen from the side

enemies.name: Patrol Drone
enemies.look: A hovering spherical chrome drone with a single red optical eye and dual stubby propellers.
enemies.fighting_style: Hovers just out of reach and dives at the player while firing tiny laser bursts.
moves: Zap Beam (Fires a quick low-damage laser bolt)
Dive Bomb (Dives headfirst into the player)

enemies.name: Campus Droid
enemies.look: A bipedal robotic guard made of white polished plastic panels with blue LED visor strips.
enemies.fighting_style: Marches forward delivering precise robotic jabs and defensive blocks.
moves: Shock Palm (Stuns the player with an electrified hand strike)

enemies.name: Cyborg Enforcer
enemies.look: A heavily armored cyborg with exposed metallic shoulders, red mechanical eyes, and a spiked gauntlet.
enemies.personality: Cold and unstoppable, Kengore's elite muscle
enemies.fighting_style: Slow, heavy-hitting brawler who walks through punches and crushes with his gauntlet.
moves: Iron Jab: a heavy straight punch with his free fist
Gauntlet Smash: raises his arm high and smashes it down

source.parsed_text:
Kengore is the cybernetic version of Tonian.  He considers himself the epitome of human evolution and is trying to conquer campus with an army droids and drones.
